about: Behaviour table of the worker's fake lyrics provider (worker lyrics/fake.py, audio-ingest 006:T028) and fake aligner (alignment/fake.py, stem-separation 006:T041) for STEMSTUDIO_FAKE_LYRICS (only with STEMSTUDIO_SEPARATOR=fake). Started as the qa proposal (006:T012); the 006+008 integration run aligned it with the implementation: the four self-written FAKE_LINES are spread evenly over the track (line i of n starts at floor(durationMs / (n + 1)) * (i + 1)), words interpolated. `lines` are the values for the 20 s fake-stack fixture music_100bpm_20s.* as served by GET /api/tracks/{id}/lyrics; no gap between lines is longer than countdownGapMs, so the fake track has no gap countdown. e2e/support/lyrics.ts reads its expectations from this file. All text is self-written.

text.plainText:
Fake line one
La la la
Fixture words here
Sing along now
text.pastedText:
Pasted line one
Pasted line two for the ball

failed.error: Lyrics could not be retrieved; try again later.

fakeAlignment.rule: word k (counted over the whole text, line breaks kept) starts at firstWordMs + k * wordMs and ends wordMs later; a line spans its words

spread.rule: line i (0-based) of n starts at floor(durationMs / (n + 1)) * (i + 1); words interpolated
